prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production candidate pixel-art movement sprite sheet for Hollow Choir, top-down 3/4 RPG, transparent RGBA PNG.
Input image 1: character identity reference only. Create NEW overworld art; do not edit the combat portrait.
Subject: The Hollow, a small traveller with ivory hood and bone-white expressionless mask with black eye holes, moss olive scarf, charcoal/slate ragged coat, brown backpack and boots, short sword SHEATHED at belt. Preserve that costume throughout all sixteen frames.
MANDATORY SHEET GEOMETRY: square 1024x1024, exactly 4 columns by 4 rows, each cell 256x256. No labels, no lines, no checkerboard. Every cell one entire character, centered x=128 in its cell, feet baseline y=224 in its cell. Character body approximately 128 pixels wide and 192 high. Work as deliberate 32x48 pixel sprite enlarged exactly 4x, hard square pixel clusters, nearest-neighbour appearance, no antialias. Wide transparent gutters on all sides. Every sprite same scale and foot pivot, no equipment outside its cell.
ROWS, from top: facing SOUTH toward viewer; facing WEST left; facing EAST right; facing NORTH away from viewer. Show proper back of hood/backpack in NORTH row, not a frontal face.
COLUMNS in every row: left-foot-forward contact; centered passing stance; right-foot-forward contact; second passing stance. A convincing restrained walking cycle: legs clearly alternate, small arm counter-swing, scarf and coat follow minimally. Do not repeat the same pose four times. No sword swinging, no combat, no dust, no shadow, no circles. Mouth and face immutable.
Palette: warm near-black #171a17, charcoal slate, bone #d0c2a2 and #f1ead5, olive #66713b, muted brown and tarnished brass #a88b50. Upper-left tiny material highlights, no dramatic light. Consistent 16-bit RPG pixel craft, simple readable silhouettes, not cute chibi, not high-resolution illustration.
Transparent background must be genuine alpha including all gutters. No decorative background, frame, text, watermark or grid.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent pixel-art overworld enemy idle-animation sheet for Hollow Choir.
Input images 1–3: identity/material references only (Thornhound, Bogshell, Rotcap Brute). Create NEW top-down three-quarter sprites rather than shrinking or editing the battle portraits.
Canvas: wide 1536x1024 with exactly FOUR equal columns and TWO equal rows (384x512 cells), transparent gutters, no dividers or text. Each sprite centered horizontally, stable feet baseline y=448 within its cell. Sprite mass approximately 270 wide and 300 high. All objects entirely inside their own cell. Use coarse intentional 4x square pixel clusters, crisp stepped contours, muted 16-bit RPG style. No gradients, cast shadows, glow haze, pedestal or scenery.
ROW 1 all four columns: the SAME small fen patrol silhouette, a low broad BOGSHELL, mossy charcoal crab-shell with ivory bracket mushrooms and two worn brass-brown claws, with one THORNHOUND behind its left shoulder (lean bone-grey hound with rust growth and sparse branch spines); small single muted cyan fen wisp behind right shoulder. Three creatures clearly one compact encounter GROUP, not merged anatomies. View three-quarter facing down-left, readable low wide silhouette.
ROW 2 all four columns: the SAME bell-guard encounter silhouette, a tall ROOTCAP BRUTE (gnarled charcoal root humanoid beneath broad asymmetrical rusty mushroom cap with bone rim), one tiny pale SPORECALLER mushroom cluster to its right, one small THORNHOUND to its left. Taller than patrol, three discrete creatures, not fused limbs. Same facing down-left.
COLUMNS: neutral; slight inhale; neutral; slight exhale. Minute breathing/shell or cap settling only. Feet and root positions stay pinned to identical anchors, no walking or attacks. Same bodies and scale across all four frames. No dramatic pose changes.
Palette: warm near-black #171a17, peat #333a30, moss #66713b, rust #9b513b, brass #a88b50, bone #d0c2a2, tiny cold cyan wisp. Ivory rims are small accents, not white surfaces.
True transparent alpha background everywhere outside the sprites. No checkerboard, no landscape, labels, borders, symbols, UI or watermarks.

Use case: background-extraction.
Edit target: the supplied enemy-group sprite sheet. Remove the entire painted dark/olive/brown background and all glow haze, leaving ONLY the eight discrete groups of pixel creatures. Genuine transparent alpha outside creature contours and between creatures. Preserve the exact 1536x1024 canvas, 4 columns x 2 rows, all original creature pixels, positions, shapes, colors, poses, scale and crisp contour details. Keep the tiny cyan wisp itself but remove its surrounding luminous haze. Do not repaint or redesign the sprites. Do not add shadows, text, borders, checkerboard or background color. Output a clean transparent RGBA sprite sheet.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: square modular pixel-art terrain TILE ATLAS for a top-down 3/4 RPG, Hollow Choir's Briarfen / Gloamstead. This is a tile library, not a painted map.
Exactly FOUR columns by FOUR rows, sixteen square cells filling a square 1024x1024 canvas, every cell 256x256. No spacing, margins, frame, grid lines, labels or text. Every tile fills its entire cell edge-to-edge. Design each cell as a native 32x32 tile enlarged exactly 8x, visible intentional large square pixels, crisp edges and small simple clusters. No antialias, painterly detail or high-resolution texture.
Palette muted dusk: peat near-black #171a17 and #333a30, olive moss #66713b, desaturated blue-green water #263e40, brown plank wood, pale worn stone #a79f80. No lighting halos, reflections of buildings, objects, trees, gradients or perspective vanishing point.
ROW 1 left to right: seamless dark peat earth; seamless dark shallow fen water with very sparse short horizontal ripples; seamless warm packed dirt footpath; seamless weathered stone paving with small flat irregular cobbles.
ROW 2 left to right: horizontal water-bank edge with earth at TOP and water BOTTOM; vertical water-bank edge earth RIGHT and water LEFT; horizontal edge earth BOTTOM and water TOP; vertical edge earth LEFT and water RIGHT. The bank crosses the exact midpoint of each tile. All four share the exact same water and earth colors. No reeds obscuring edges.
ROW 3 left to right: north-south boardwalk of worn brown planks, 75 percent tile width, dark water on both sides; east-west boardwalk, 75 percent tile height, dark water above/below; right-angle boardwalk connecting NORTH and EAST edges, water remaining corner; four-way boardwalk crossing. Planks and beams meet exactly at tile edges, identical boardwalk widths and neutral color. No rope railings, no shadows outside cells.
ROW 4 left to right: rounded convex earth-bank corner earth in NORTHWEST quadrant and water elsewhere; earth NORTHEAST; earth SOUTHEAST; earth SOUTHWEST. Same bank midpoint and materials as row 2.
Perfect orthographic floor tiles, top-down with minimal surface shading only, flat repeatable borders. Solid opaque atlas, no background scene. No characters or props.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent pixel-art village MODULE ATLAS for Hollow Choir's Gloamstead, fixed top-down three-quarter RPG camera. Separate walls and roofs for editable map layering, plus a Bellkeeper NPC.
Canvas wide1536x1024, exactly FOUR columns x TWO rows, cells384x512. No labels, borders, grid or text. Each object entirely inside its cell, centered, wide genuine transparent gutters. Coarse intentional 16-bit pixel clusters, warm near-black contour, muted soot timber, ivory stone, olive moss, patched ivory cloth and tarnished brass. No cast shadows, terrain or backdrop.
TOP ROW:
Column1: Stillroom building WALL BASE ONLY, small rectangular low ivory-stone footing, soot timber front, closed plain dark door, one modest side window, a short flat eave support along the top. No roof. Front entrance faces viewer. Body about300wide x220high.
Column2: Home building WALL BASE ONLY, slightly narrower soot-dark timber front, worn ivory plaster, closed door and two small windows, NO roof. Same front plane and scale.
Column3: Workshop WALL BASE ONLY, wider ivory rubble footings, soot timber, broad closed double door, worn oxblood fabric hanging at side, NO roof. Same plane and scale.
Column4: Bellkeeper NPC, standing relaxed front-facing, elderly human with warm brown skin, short grey hair, simple ivory apron over charcoal robe, moss scarf, small brass handbell held low in one hand, brown boots. Full body, restrained human proportions, no halo, no floor. Approximately120wide x240high.
BOTTOM ROW:
Column1: Stillroom ROOF ONLY to sit over column1 walls, steep moss-dark charcoal shingles, narrow chimney, patched ivory roof cloth. Standalone cap, exactly matching300pixel footprint width, no wall, no door.
Column2: Home ROOF ONLY matching column2 width and camera, hipped dark brown shingles, low patched moss ridgeline. No walls.
Column3: Workshop ROOF ONLY matching column3 width/camera, asymmetrical broad charcoal plank roof with a small tarnished metal vent. No walls.
Column4: SAME Bellkeeper NPC same position/scale/appearance, tiny idle inhale change only; fixed feet, do not change clothing or gesture.
Ground-facing building fronts horizontal, no isometric diamond footprint. Roof tiles show the roof's top plane consistently with elevated RPG camera. Buildings have no readable writing or shop symbols and doors stay decorative closed. NPC same palette and pixel density as buildings.
True transparent alpha everywhere outside objects. No checkerboard, glow, atmospheric haze, shadows, scenery, labels, watermarks or extra objects.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one transparent pixel-art open reed-fence GATEWAY for Hollow Choir's top-down exploration map. Reuse the worn charcoal timber / olive reed / tarnished brass materials of the supplied prop-sheet style reference; create a NEW standalone object.
Subject: two squat weathered timber posts on low ivory stone feet, one on the left and one on the right, with short reed-fence stubs pointing OUTWARD to the sides. The MIDDLE is a broad COMPLETELY EMPTY walking gap. No central door, no barrier, no fence panel, no chain, no sill, no ground patch. A thin high timber crossbeam may connect posts above head height, creating a clear entry silhouette.
View: orthographic elevated top-down three-quarter RPG, front-facing opening, not an isometric diamond. Deliberate 16-bit pixel clusters, approximately native96wide x64high enlarged8x on a1024squarecanvas, generous transparent margin all sides. Upper-left tiny material highlights only. Warm near-black #171a17 contours, charcoal wood, dull olive reeds and ivory stone.
Genuine transparent RGBA alpha outside the posts, stubs and high crossbeam AND INSIDE the large central gap. No background, cast shadow, glow, text, labels, checkerboard, landscape or watermark. A player can visibly walk straight through the opening.
